title: executor.claim-token reply
description: Status 200 with the token for the winner of a current claim; 409 claim_rejected for every other Executor, a lost or ended claim or a task that is not current; 409 claim_not_processed before the named created is processed; 503 service_unavailable for an Executor not yet projected. The only broker message that carries a claim token. Error replies use error.reply.schema.json.
